the photocatalytic performance of noble metals doped nano ZnO photocatalysts is highly dependent on the type of noble metal and the amount of doping.

Pd doped ZnO is the most suitable photocatalyst for the degradation of organic pollutants.

the noble metals doped photocatalysts can be a promising material for environmental applications.
